latest_release.name: CesiumJS 1.147
latest_release.body:
1.147 - 2026-11-02

Highlights include: 

- Support for the `KHR_materials_emissive_strength_extension`.
- Experimental `IonAssetElementService` for querying, filtering, aggregating, and navigating element metadata for Cesium ion assets backed by BIM/CAD databases.
- Several bug fixes for visual fidelity and performance.


See the [changelog](https://github.com/CesiumGS/cesium/blob/1.147/CHANGES.md) for the complete list of changes.
